title: Accessible tabs
summary: Build tabs with the right roles, states and arrow-key navigation.
prompt: Finish `Tabs`. Render a `tablist` (labelled by `label`) of `tab` buttons and one `tabpanel` per tab. The selected tab has `aria-selected="true"` and `tabIndex` 0, and the others have `"false"` and -1. Each tab's `aria-controls` points at its panel, and inactive panels are `hidden`. Clicking a tab selects it. ArrowRight and ArrowLeft move selection and focus, wrapping at the ends.
hints: Build ids with `useId()`, for example `${id}-tab-${index}` and `${id}-panel-${index}`.
Keep an array of button refs, or look up the next tab by id, and call `.focus()` after selecting.
